reference.code: fn nums(s:&str)->Option<Vec<i32>>{if s.is_empty(){return None}let mut o=vec![];for z in s.split(','){let x:i32=z.parse().ok()?;if x.to_string()!=z||x< -1000||x>1000{return None}o.push(x)}Some(o)}fn join(a:&[i32])->String{a.iter().map(|x|x.to_string()).collect::<Vec<_>>().join(",")}pub fn consecutive_run_summary(s:&str)->Option<String>{let a=nums(s)?;let mut o=vec![];let mut i=0;while i<a.len(){let mut q=i+1;while q<a.len()&&a[q]==a[i]{q+=1}o.push(format!("{}:{}",a[i],q-i));i=q}Some(o.join(","))}
